title: Launchpad: onboarding mini-tour — empty states, microcopy & screenshot toolkit
creator: Lena Rodriguez
description: Scope: produce a compact ‘Launchpad’ mini-tour that surfaces during first console use (top-right launch icon). Deliverables: a screenshot toolkit and annotated exports for engineering, 3 microcopy variations for empty states and inline tips, a small set of vector illustrations for empty-device and no-workspace states, and responsive behavior notes for mobile/tablet. Goal: reduce time-to-first-success for engineers by making the minimal onboarding path discoverable without blocking advanced users. This ticket bundles the visual assets, copy variants, and a screenshot export recipe (size, naming, alt text) needed by the release team.
design_notes: Components: toast-like anchored card (max width 420px), 12px corner radius, elevation 600. Color tokens: --redwood-bg= #0F1722, --accent= #6C8EFF, --muted= #8B95A6. Microcopy lengths: title <= 6 words, body <= 20 words, CTA primary 1–2 words. Accessibility: AA contrast for text on card background; tooltip arrow 8px. Animation: subtle slide + fade (150ms). Mobile: card stacks full width with 16px side padding. Include localization keys and token examples in Figma exports.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file ‘Launchpad-MiniTour-v3’ contains annotated frames for desktop, tablet, mobile
Exported PNG/SVG assets following the naming convention and with alt text provided
Three copy variants provided and tagged for A/B test in PRD
Developer-ready CSS token spec and one example React snippet attached
QA checklist passed: visual, keyboard focus, screenreader label presence
